exercises.prompt: How is a proposal different from a report?
exercises.answer: It suggests future action and tries to persuade.
exercises.explanation: Propozycja patrzy w przyszłość i przekonuje.

exercises.prompt: Which sentence is a good opening?
exercises.answer: This proposal outlines a plan to reduce energy costs in our office.
distractors: Hi everyone, I've got an idea!

exercises.prompt: I recommend that the company ___ in new software. (invest – subjunctive)
exercises.answer: invest
accept: should invest

exercises.prompt: The initial cost would be ___ by long-term savings. (zrekompensowany)
exercises.answer: offset
accept: outweighed
balanced

exercises.prompt: Ułóż wstęp propozycji.
answer: The purpose of this proposal is to suggest ways of improving staff wellbeing.
It is based on feedback from a recent employee survey.
exercises.explanation: Nagłówek, cel, źródło. Potoczne zakończenie nie pasuje.

exercises.prompt: I would propose that the canteen opens earlier.

Zamień na formalną propozycję, zacznij od „It would be advisable”.
We should hire two more people.
exercises.answer: It would be advisable to hire two more people.
accept: It would be advisable to recruit two more people.
It would be advisable to employ two more people.
It would be advisable to hire two additional people.

exercises.prompt: Jestem przekonany, że te zmiany przyniosą korzyści.
exercises.answer: I am confident that these changes would be beneficial.
accept: I am confident that these changes will be beneficial.
I am convinced that these changes would be beneficial.
I am confident that these changes would bring benefits.
I am confident that these changes will bring benefits.
I am sure that these changes will be beneficial.

exercises.prompt: Which heading suits a proposal?
exercises.answer: Proposed changes

exercises.prompt: Połącz zwroty z ich funkcją.
Which sentence presents a benefit?
exercises.answer: This would enable staff to work more flexibly.

exercises.prompt: Which sentence is suitably cautious?
exercises.answer: It is likely that productivity would increase.

exercises.prompt: One option ___ be to introduce flexible hours.
exercises.meaning: Jedną z możliwości byłoby wprowadzenie elastycznych godzin pracy.
exercises.answer: would

exercises.prompt: Many employees have expressed ___ about the lack of parking. (obawy)
exercises.answer: concern
accept: concerns

exercises.prompt: Ułóż sekcję z korzyściami.
answer: The new system would reduce costs by around 15%.
Furthermore, it would enable staff to save time on routine tasks.
exercises.explanation: Nagłówek i dwie korzyści. Zakończenie listu nie pasuje.

exercises.prompt: This solution would enable staff to working from home.

Zamień na formalny zwrot, zacznij od „I would urge”.
Please, board, accept this plan.
exercises.answer: I would urge the board to accept this plan.
accept: I would urge the board to approve this plan.
I would urge the board to adopt this plan.

exercises.prompt: Obecnie wielu pracowników dojeżdża samochodem.
exercises.answer: At present, many employees commute by car.
accept: At present, many employees drive to work.
Currently, many employees commute by car.
Currently, many employees drive to work.
At present many employees commute by car.
At present, a lot of employees drive to work.

exercises.prompt: What should the conclusion of a proposal do?
exercises.answer: Encourage the reader to approve the plan.

exercises.prompt: Połącz wyrażenia z tłumaczeniem.
Which sentence suggests a gradual approach?
exercises.answer: I would recommend starting with a three-month pilot scheme.

exercises.prompt: Funds should be ___ to staff training.
exercises.answer: allocated

exercises.prompt: The plan could be ___ in stages. (wdrożony)
exercises.answer: implemented
accept: introduced

exercises.prompt: ___ the long term, the investment would pay for itself.
exercises.meaning: W dłuższej perspektywie inwestycja by się zwróciła.
exercises.answer: In

exercises.prompt: Ułóż zakończenie propozycji.
answer: The proposed changes would benefit both the company and its employees.
I would therefore urge the management to approve them.
exercises.explanation: Nagłówek, podsumowanie, wezwanie. Zwrot z listu nie pasuje.

exercises.prompt: It is essential that the plan is approved before May.

Zamień na nominalizację, zacznij od „The introduction of”.
If we introduce flexible hours, staff will be happier.
exercises.answer: The introduction of flexible hours would make staff happier.
accept: The introduction of flexible hours will make staff happier.
The introduction of flexible hours would make the staff happier.

exercises.prompt: Proponuję, aby firma przydzieliła więcej środków na szkolenia.
exercises.answer: I propose that the company allocate more funds to training.
accept: I propose that the company should allocate more funds to training.
I suggest that the company allocate more funds to training.
I suggest that the company should allocate more funds to training.
I propose that the company allocates more funds to training.

exercises.prompt: Which verb form is typical of proposals?
exercises.answer: would + infinitive
